description: This file defines the ListView class used for rendering and managing list views in the SugarCRM-based application. It includes methods for setting query parameters, themes, language strings, and handling session variables. The class is central to managing list display logic across different modules.

classes.name: ListView
classes.description: A generic list view class for displaying lists of records with configurable query, theme, language strings, and session handling.

methods.name: ListView
methods.description: Constructor method initializes the ListView object, setting default properties and theme based on global variables.

methods.name: setHeaderTitle
methods.description: Sets the header title for the list view.

methods.name: setHeaderText
methods.description: Sets the header text, typically used for buttons or additional info in the list view header.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Configures the database query with where clause, limit, order by, and manages session variables related to sorting.

methods.name: setTheme
methods.description: Sets the visual theme for the list view.

methods.name: setAppStrings
methods.description: Sets the application language strings for UI labels.

methods.name: setImagePath
methods.description: Sets the path for images used in the list view.

methods.name: setCurrentModule
methods.description: Sets the current module context for the list view.

methods.name: setSessionVariable
methods.description: Internal method to set a session variable related to list view preferences.

methods.name: setUserVariable
methods.description: Internal method to set a user preference for list view settings.

methods.name: getSessionVariable
methods.description: Retrieves a session or request variable related to list view state.

methods.name: getSessionVariableName
methods.description: Returns the session/query variable name for internal use.
